regime.summary: Policy rate is on hold at 10.5% but the bill curve prices hikes, CPI is rising and Brent has risen 83% in three months. The index fell over three months but bounced 7% in the last month. This resembles tightening with external stress, where the method says hold bills and set a trigger to return, so I stay neutral with low exposure and no new entries.
